title: Cech homology commutes with objectwise homology
statement: A natural isomorphism identifies vertical homology of the Cech bicomplex of any cochain complex of abelian presheaves with the Cech complex of its objectwise homology presheaf.

proof.text: Each Cech-degree functor is evaluation on the corresponding formal coproduct. Apply formalCoproductEval_preservesHomology [lem-sc-formal-coproduct-evaluation-homology] to obtain its canonical ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso.

Evaluation in the presheaf category preserves homology. Assemble its canonical mapHomologyIso inverses into evalHomologyIso: K.homology q is naturally isomorphic to the objectwise homology presheaf. NatTrans.app_homology proves naturality on each arrow.

Compose the degreewise homology comparison with the Cech-degree image of evalHomologyIso. Regard the Cech differential as a natural transformation between degree functors. NatTrans.app_homology and naturality of that differential prove the chain-map equation. HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents assembles the comparison into the required isomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem cechComplexFunctor_homology {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [HasFiniteProducts C] {ι : Type v} (U : ι → C) (K : CochainComplex (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v}) ℕ) (q : ℕ) : Nonempty (((HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor _ (ComplexShape.up ℕ) q).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (HomologicalComplex₂.flip (((cechComplexFunctor U).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj K)) ≅ (cechComplexFunctor U).obj (K.asFunctor ⋙ HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor _ (ComplexShape.up ℕ) q))
